`businessRuleIds` is what feeds the rule→story coverage. Each id has to reference an `artifact.business_rule` event that EXISTS — validation rejects a made-up id. The response also carries `semanticDuplicate` (RN-681): an embedding-based WARNING against the project stories, never a refusal.
